openCodeOnlySkills.opencode: OpenCode built-in skill about OpenCode itself. Replaced by the Hermes bundled skill hermes-agent.
openCodeOnlySkills.report: OpenCode built-in skill for filing OpenCode bug reports. No Hermes equivalent.

roles.name: director
roles.description: Director of the /org team. Turns a goal into workstreams for the managers, arbitrates, orders the final audit and reports back. Start work with /org <task>.

roles.name: manager-impl
roles.description: Manager of the implementation workstream. Splits work into disjoint-scope cards for worker-coder, worker-science and worker-writer, confirms the result with worker-qa, and reports to the director.

roles.name: manager-quality
roles.description: Manager of the quality workstream. Directs worker-coder (test files only) and worker-qa to write and run tests, lint, type checks and builds, and reviews changes for correctness.

roles.name: manager-research
roles.description: Manager of the research workstream. Splits questions into independent read-only investigations for worker-research, cross-checks the answers and delivers an evidenced findings report.

roles.name: auditor
roles.description: Independent final auditor of the /org team. Reviews finished work against the original goal, read-only, and returns APPROVE or REJECT with findings.

roles.name: worker-coder
roles.description: Implements one narrowly scoped coding, data or ML task and edits only files inside its assigned scope.

roles.name: worker-qa
roles.description: Runs tests, linters, type checks and builds and reports exact commands and output. Does not modify files.

roles.name: worker-research
roles.description: Performs one read-only investigation (code search, docs, literature and database lookup, web) and reports an answer with sources.

roles.name: worker-writer
roles.description: Produces one document deliverable (manuscript, report, slides, poster, figure, diagram or research note). Never invents facts or references.

roles.name: worker-science
roles.description: Implements one narrowly scoped science task: bioinformatics, omics, biomedical imaging and clinical-research data, or chemistry, materials, physics, quantum computing and simulation.
